newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end rally, close flat.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end rally, close flat.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed broadly flat in light trading Tuesday, ending a record-breaking rally, but traders forecast further gains after some market adjustment.
"There was some profit-taking, but only in light volume, which suggests share prices are still supported," Westsphere brokerage director Enrique Lerner said.
Today's dip "was expected, healthy and necessary after so many uninterrupted days of rises," he said.

The bolsa's 19-share index closed down 0.1 percent at 7,634.14 as 75 million shares, worth 9.8 billion bolivars ($20 milion), changed hands, according to preliminary figures. The index has risen over 22 percent since the beginning of May.
Traders said strong, but sideways, trade in market leader Electricidad de Caracas suggested further rises were in store for the market.
"Resilient demand kept that share price up," said one.
Among the day's traded issues, 23 fell, 14 rose and nine closed flat.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, slipped 0.57 percent to close at 119.22.

Foreign investors have been drawn to Caracas equities due to improving Venezuelan economic prospects. A nine percent rise in May bank lending was just the latest sign of a growing economic recovery that officials say will lead to over four percent growth this year.
